name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal window for a focused task, with a title, body and footer actions, in small to full-screen sizes.

when: A short task that needs focus without leaving the page: edit, create, confirm details.

instead.when: The task needs a side panel next to the page.
The user must confirm or cancel one action.

guidance.rule: One primary action; the secondary action closes.
Use fullscreen for long tasks like a signup, xlarge for two- or three-column forms.

keyboard.does: Moves focus inside the dialog only.

builtIn: Focus moves to the first field and returns to the opener on close.
Named by its title, described by its description.
youProvide: A title that says what the task is.
